subject: general
question:
Select the letter that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

B : H :: P : V :: N : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fcf31a2941582fee41e74adb0b3eb4ad1d50dc3436a7c2050e17724c7224929.png] 

The logic followed here is: **2nd letter - 6 = 1st letter**

B : H ⇒ 8 (H) - 6 = B

P : V ⇒ 22 (V) - 6 = P

Similarly, **N : ? ⇒ 14 (N) + 6 = T**

Hence, the correct answer is** "T".**
